review_type: Independent read-only inspection, not a rerun of the implementation author's focused tests or final film acceptance.
accepted_properties: Finite original NOAA model temperature always takes precedence, including legitimate zero. Estimated temperature supplements only missing temperature in provider2.
Exact hourly endpoint uses itself; intermediate scalar interpolation requires both finite endpoints. Time wrap and extrapolation are rejected.
Compact temperature indices map one-to-one onto the original regular display grid, with no unrepresented or duplicate compact index.
Loader checks binary hashes, dimensions, little-endian Float32/Int32 layout and frozen velocity-field hash.

Renderer additionally requires identical absolute ISO UTC axes between lake and river temperature, identical regular-grid geometry, and an estimated-temperature index for every valid provider2 display cell.
Estimated T is sampled independently from U/V, then mapped through the same temperature palette for base water and trails. This helper never supplies or modifies velocity.
scientific_interpretation: Original NOAA temperature and the new passive river tracer are both model-derived quantities with different physical scope. The custom river tracer must remain explicitly labelled as an unvalidated estimate; internal variable names such as actualTemperature do not imply observations.
